description: This file is a shell script implementing configuration and setup functions for IPv4-in-IPv6 tunneling protocols, specifically ipip6 and ds-lite, used for network configuration in OpenWrt or similar embedded Linux environments.

methods.name: tnl_setup
methods.description: Sets up a tunnel with specified configuration parameters including tunnel type, addresses, and options.

methods.name: init_config
methods.description: Initializes common configuration parameters for tunneling protocols.

methods.name: proto_ipip6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration specifically for ipip6 protocol.

methods.name: proto_ipip6_setup
methods.description: Sets up ipip6 tunnel using provided configuration.

methods.name: proto_dslite_setup
methods.description: Sets up ds-lite tunnel with default parameters.
